hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Picture $4$ bags with $5$ marbles in each, plus $2$ loose marbles. The total number of marbles is the value of $y$.
Use the given $x$ in the rule and keep the order of operations in mind.
With $x = 4$ the rule becomes $y = 5(4) + 2$. Multiply first, then add $2$.
$5 \times 4 = 20$ and $20 + 2 = 22$, so the value of $y$ is $22$.

explanation: Substitute $4$ for $x$ in the given rule: $y = 5(4) + 2$.
Multiply first, because $5x$ means $5$ times $x$, which gives $5 \times 4 = 20$.
Then add the $2$ to that product to get $20 + 2 = 22$.
So the value of $y$ is $22$ when $x = 4$.
